name: Abu Dhabi International Airport
description: One of the largest transportation hubs in the Middle East, the airport boasts a modern design, high throughput, and premium infrastructure. It features spacious VIP lounges, comfortable lounges, dedicated Fast Track lanes, and personalized assistance for passengers who value comfort and speed. Abu Dhabi is known for its impeccable service and attention to detail—the ideal choice for travelers looking for a stress-free start to their trip.

guides.title: Departure
guides.description:
Meeting and Check-in

  • The passenger arrives at the airport in advance (2 hours before an international flight, 1 hour 30 minutes before for a domestic flight);
  • An assistant will meet you at a designated Fast Track entrance, at the parking lot, or at the passenger drop-off area;
  • Assistance with baggage and escort to the check-in counter;
  • Assistance to the Business/Priority counters, if needed.

Security Check

  • Fast-track security through a dedicated Fast Track corridor;
  • Priority passport control without the general queue;
  • Escort by an assistant to the boarding gate;
  • If there is no jet bridge, you will be transported to the aircraft in a separate vehicle.

guides.title: Arrival
guides.description:
Meeting at the Airplane

  • An assistant meets the passenger at the boarding ramp or at the terminal entrance;
  • If there is no boarding ramp, a personal transfer from the aircraft to the terminal;
  • Escort along a dedicated Fast Track corridor.

Checkpoint Pass

  • Priority passport control without queuing;
  • Assistance with baggage at the carousel;
  • Escort to the exit, parking, or to those meeting you;
  • If necessary, assistance with transfers to other transport.

guides.title: What is important to know
guides.description:
Cancellation Policy

  • Cancelling a confirmed service less than 48 hours before the scheduled time will incur a 100% penalty;
  • Passenger no-show will incur a 100% penalty;
  • Changes to a confirmed request are possible subject to availability at the airport.

Urgent Requests

  • Reservations made less than 48 hours in advance are considered urgent;
  • Urgent surcharge: +5,000 ₽ per passenger.

Passenger Details

  • To confirm the service, the following may be required: flight number, full name as per passport, contact phone number, and baggage information;
  • Important: Timely Please confirm your departure/arrival terminal—this will affect the meeting location.

Airport Arrival Time

  • International flights: We recommend arriving at least 2 hours in advance;
  • Domestic flights: We recommend arriving at least 1 hour 30 minutes in advance;
  • For traveling with animals or when transporting weapons, please arrive at least 2 hours 30 minutes in advance.

Escort

  • The assistant will meet you only in the area specified in your confirmation (dedicated entrance, parking lot, terminal, jetway, or transfer area);
  • If there is no jetway, separate transportation to the terminal will be provided.
